findings.fix: Route pointercancel through the same synchronous teardown as pointerup: clear the active sash and resize state, release pointer capture, and ignore subsequent moves for the canceled pointer without waiting for pointerup.
findings.repro: Begin dragging the constrained-layout sash, dispatch pointercancel, then move the pointer before releasing it; the next frame still shows the bright-blue active sash until the later pointerup.
findings.title: Pointer cancellation leaves the sash active until pointerup
